author: human
request:
Bug report: opening /owners?page=0 — or any page value below 1 — renders the
error page instead of the owner list. Expected behavior: the owner listing
treats any page value below 1 as the first page and responds with the normal
listing (HTTP 200). Find the cause, fix it, and cover the fix with a test.

author: product-requirements-expert
title: Owner listing opens the first page when a page before the first is asked for
summary: Asking to view a page of the owner listing before the first one shows the first page of the listing rather than an error page.
acceptance_criteria: given owners to list, when a page before the first one is asked for, then the first page of the listing is shown rather than an error page
a page selection of zero opens the first page of the listing
any negative page selection opens the first page of the listing
non_goals: paging behavior of the veterinarian directory — the owner's report names the owner listing only
a page selection past the last page — recorded as an open question, undecided
a page selection that is not a number — recorded as an open question, undecided
notes: Scope traces to the intake-decision at handoff.jsonl line 1 (author: human), whose decisions array is empty; the request is quoted verbatim there. Owner's stated expectation: 'the owner listing treats any page value below 1 as the first page and responds with the normal listing (HTTP 200)'. PRD covers this as REQ-OWN-005 with edge case 4 under Owner records. No Non-Goals row changed, so no scope_overrides. No ubiquitous-language term resolved by the intake.

author: system-design-expert
architectural_fit: The slice is a request-binding correction inside an existing contract. docs/system-design.md Contracts already names OwnerController as the owner search-with-paging surface; that row now also carries REQ-OWN-005. No new type, package, or pattern. The paging helper computes the zero-based page index as page - 1, so a page value below 1 yields a negative index and PageRequest.of rejects it, surfacing the error page (grep of OwnerController.java:133-137; no IDE oracle connected, so this is the weaker textual basis rather than a resolved-symbol citation). Normalizing the requested page to the first page is the Web controller row's binding duty in architecture-principles.md, not a business rule, so the no-new-rule-in-controllers checklist item is not engaged.
integration_points: processFindForm feeds the same page value to two consumers: findPaginatedForOwnersLastName (repository query) and addPaginationModel (model attribute currentPage). Normalize once at the method entry so both see the corrected value.

owners/ownersList.html builds the first/previous/next/last links from currentPage; an unnormalized value would render links pointing at a page before the first, reintroducing the defect one click away.

patterns.description: existing MockMvc listing test: perform GET /owners?page=N, assert status 200 and view name owners/ownersList. The two new tests follow this shape with page=0 and a negative page.

risks.risk: Clamping inside findPaginatedForOwnersLastName only, leaving addPaginationModel to publish the raw value as currentPage. The listing would return 200 while its pagination links point below the first page.
risks.mitigation: Normalize before both calls and assert the currentPage model attribute in the new tests (architecture-principles.md Web controller row: the controller binds the request once, then delegates).

risks.risk: Generalizing the fix to VetController, which computes its page index the same way.
risks.mitigation: The prd-entry records veterinarian-directory paging as a non-goal; leave VetController untouched (docs/prd.md REQ-OWN-005).

risks.risk: Widening the fix to a page past the last page or a non-numeric page value.
risks.mitigation: Both are recorded as undecided open questions in docs/prd.md; out of scope for this slice.

notes: Effort routine: the change is a clamp on one already-bound parameter plus two tests that mirror an adjacent test in the same class. No docs/adr entry warranted — no alternative with a real trade-off. Design write for this slice was the Contracts row above; the defect is newly reported and is not one of the Known Defects rows, so that table is unchanged. No design-doc-autofix records exist in the log, so the autofix audit is empty.

author: security-reviewer
recommendations: Supply chain was not verified against the NVD in this review: the OWASP `dependencyCheck` plugin is not configured in `build.gradle`, so `dependencyCheckAnalyze` could not run and no CVE match was performed. This is out of scope for this diff (no dependency changed) but leaves the framework-CVE check to CI or a human.

Two page-selection classes remain unhandled and are already logged as an open PRD question: a selection past the last page (renders an empty listing), and a non-numeric selection (binding type-mismatch reaching the error page, which renders the underlying exception message). Neither is introduced or worsened here; the second is the one with an information-disclosure flavor and is worth settling when that question is answered.
approved_aspects: Boundary validation is at the boundary: the request-derived `page` is normalized once at controller entry (`Math.max(page, FIRST_PAGE)`) before it reaches the query or the model, matching security-principles.md 'Validate at the boundary'.

Strictly stronger than the baseline: a page selection below 1 previously reached `PageRequest.of(page - 1, 5)` and threw IllegalArgumentException, surfacing an internal exception message on the error page. Normalization removes that error-path information disclosure; no new error path is introduced.

No injection surface: the value flows into Spring Data's `PageRequest`/derived query `findByLastNameStartingWith`, never into concatenated query text, a path, a shell, or a template expression. No `Runtime`/`ProcessBuilder`, file I/O, deserialization, or reflection in the diff.
No arithmetic hazard: `Math.max` cannot overflow, and the normalized minimum of 1 keeps `page - 1` non-negative for every int input, including Integer.MIN_VALUE.
No output-escaping change: `currentPage` is an int model attribute rendered through Thymeleaf's default escaping; no template was modified and no markup is composed from request-derived text.
No credentials, tokens, keys, or connection strings added; no logging statements added, so no log-injection or sensitive-data-in-logs surface.

No dependency, repository, or build-file change, so the supply-chain surface is unchanged by this pass (verified: `build.gradle` is not in the change set, and its `repositories` block remains `mavenCentral()` over TLS).
Mass assignment unaffected: `@RequestParam int page` binds a scalar, not an entity field; the existing `setDisallowedFields` binder for `Owner` is untouched.
Concurrency: `FIRST_PAGE` is a static final int and `pageToShow` is a method local, so the singleton controller gains no mutable shared state.
